description: 1975 yilda Kodak muhandisi Stiv Sasson birinchi raqamli kamerani yasagan: 0,01 megapiksel, rasmni kassetaga yozishga 23 soniya. Sassonning o'zi aytishicha, rahbariyat ixtirani sovuq qabul qilgan. Keyingi yillarda raqamli suratga o'tish plyonka bozorini siqib chiqardi, Kodak esa 2012 yil 19 yanvarda bankrotlikka ariza berdi. Sizning qaysi g'oyangiz hozir tortmada yotibdi?
source: PetaPixel, How Steve Sasson Invented the Digital Camera (0.01 MP, 100x100 pixels, 23 seconds to cassette), https://petapixel.com/how-steve-sasson-invented-the-digital-camera/ ; PetaPixel, What Kodak Said About Digital Photography in 1975, https://petapixel.com/2017/09/21/kodak-said-digital-photography-1975/ ; Irish Times, Portrait of inventor who saw the big picture (management less excited), https://www.irishtimes.com/business/portrait-of-inventor-who-saw-the-big-picture-1.766671 ; Engadget, Kodak files Chapter 11 on 19 January 2012, https://www.engadget.com/2012-01-19-kodak-chapter-11-bankruptcy.html ; ABC News, Kodak files Chapter 11, https://abcnews.com/Business/kodak-files-chapter-11-bankruptcy/story?id=15392485. Note: the management reaction is Sasson's own account (widely quoted from The New York Times); the claim that managers feared film sales is commentators' interpretation and was removed.
